disclaimer: Industry references summarised from engineering practice for comparison only. Values tagged 'verify' must be confirmed against the licensed standard copy before being used as alarm limits. MSETCL circular limits remain the governing criteria.

items.topic: PF of new OIP bushing at 20 °C

items.value: > 2 × nameplate → investigate; > 3 × → remove
±5 % → investigate; ±10 % → remove
Use the bushing maker's curve. OIP bushings change little between 20 and 60 °C, so a generic transformer K-factor understates the real value.
items.vsCircular: The sheet divides every bushing reading by a generic K (1.61 at 42 °C)

items.value: 0.5 – 1.0 %: acceptable but trend; > 1.0 %: investigate with oil tests & DFR
GST ≈ GSTg + UST within ~1 % — confirms lead/guard connections
items.vsCircular: not in circular (the sheet already does this check)

items.value: Judge by the trend since commissioning, not one reading. A doubling of PF between tests calls for DFR and oil moisture

ct.title: CT C & tan δ (oil-paper, Um ≥ 72.5 kV)

items.topic: Tip-up (tan δ at Um/√3 − at 10 kV)
items.vsCircular: not in circular — only possible with HV test set

items.value: ≥ 0.1 %/yr → increase monitoring; tan δ ≥ 1.0 % → replace
items.vsCircular: same rate; 1.0 % hard limit is not in the circular for CTs

items.value: DC, ≥ 50 A up to rated current
items.vsCircular: not specified in circular (Karjat uses ~100 A ✓)

items.value: ≤ 1.2 × manufacturer's type-test value (Ru)
items.vsCircular: circular uses one fixed figure per voltage class

items.value: > 20 % rise from commissioning value, or phase imbalance > 25 %, → inspect contacts
Within manufacturer's declared tolerance; break time ≤ 2 cycles (40 ms) for 400 kV
items.vsCircular: circular trip 25 ms / close 150 ms caps

items.value: Close ≤ 5 ms, Open ≤ 3.33 ms between poles
Close ≤ 2.5 ms, Open ≤ 2 ms
Total leakage is mainly capacitive, so use it only as a trend. Judge by the resistive / 3rd-harmonic component with system-harmonic compensation (method B2)
Normalise for voltage, temperature & surface moisture; ≥ 2× rise in resistive current over the arrester's own baseline → investigate

items.topic: Gas limits used in the Karjat sheet
items.value: H₂ 100 · CH₄ 120 · C₂H₂ 1 · C₂H₄ 50 · C₂H₆ 65 · CO 350 · CO₂ 2500 · TDCG 720 ppm
items.vsCircular: circular gives no limits; sheet uses these

items.value: Replaces fixed Condition 1–4 with 90th/95th-percentile tables (split by O₂/N₂ ratio & age) plus limits on gas increase (delta) and rate of rise
Basic gas ratios (C₂H₂/C₂H₄, CH₄/H₂, C₂H₄/C₂H₆) and Duval Triangle 1. Use only once gases exceed typical values
CO₂/CO < 3 suggests the fault involves paper (cellulose)
Arcing gases are normal in diverter oil; use Duval Triangle 2 (OLTC). Do not judge against main-tank limits
items.vsCircular: the sheet applies main-tank limits to OLTC samples

< 15 ppm good · 15–20 fair · > 20 poor (correct to 20 °C)
< 0.10 good · 0.10–0.15 fair · > 0.15 mg KOH/g poor
